name: properties over the serialised byte budget are rejected at track(), never enqueued
source: packages/shared/src/events.ts propertiesSchema refines JSON.stringify(p).length <= MAX_PROPERTIES_BYTES, and apps/ingestion/src/app.ts:142 parses the batch as a whole so any single invalid event answers 400. No valid events are lost — flush() isolates a non-retryable 4xx by re-sending one event at a time — but that isolation pass costs one failed batch POST plus up to batchSize individual POSTs on a mobile radio, and the offending event is dropped regardless. Rejecting at track() loses the same one event and spends no requests.
